
 Usage: houston stats [OPTIONS]

 Sample a repro's container CPU/RAM (peak over a window, or --watch live).

╭─ Options ──╮
 --name   -n      <str>
 --for            <float>  seconds to sample [default: 5.0]
 --watch  -w               stream live (Ctrl-C to stop)
 --help                    Show this message and exit.
╰──╯
